facts.text: My dad means well. He just picks dinner to have the big talk with me, so eat fast and don't mention pie.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as a character line, so it counts as a quote. Jim never says this. His dad catches him with the warm apple pie, then the awkward talks follow; he does not pick dinner for them. No such line turned up in the sources I opened.
facts.fix: Dad means well. He picks the worst moment for a talk, so eat fast and leave the pie alone.

facts.text: Stifler's party, keg in the basement.
facts.why: Wikipedia confirms the pact is made at Stifler's house party, but it never mentions a keg or a basement.
facts.fix: Stifler's party, where the pact is made.
